Game Overview

In Red and Blue Hugli Wugli, the core idea is straightforward: navigate the tricky castle with the playful Hugli Wugli brothers, zipping around on hoverboards. Dodge traps, outsmart zombies, and snatch keys to unlock freedom. Can you master the controls and collect treasures in this fast-paced, adventurous escape?
